Hi Samantha / Ben —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the VPC/on-prem cutover this week. This thread is the closure note and the handback for the final smoke validation we ran on 2026-11-07 (post-traffic flip). Summary:

- Runbook executed (playbook v1.4) across 03:30–04:45 UTC (see runbook-execution-log-20261107.txt attached).
- All high-level SLO probes passed: 99.7% p95 latency < 220ms, token throughput within targets for dedicated pools.
- Notable: brief KV-cache warmup latency spike at 03:37 UTC that was auto-mitigated by prefix-warmup behavior; no customer-impacting errors observed.

Attachments included in this mail: smoke-results-20261107.csv (per-probe logs), runbook-execution-log-20261107.txt. We will upload the complete evidence bundle and a curated excerpt for your compliance team within the hour (evidence-bundle-ACME-20261108.zip).

Action items for ACME: please review the attached CSV and confirm acceptance or call out any specific telemetry you want retained for audit. If you'd like an archived artifact in your S3 bucket, we can push the bundle there — let me know the destination.

Ops handback checklist (completed):
- Monitoring dashboards validated (Marissa)
- ACL and routing inspection complete (Laura)
- Runbook signoff captured (Priya)

Next steps:
1) I will post the evidence bundle link and a short readout here (by 08:00 PT).
2) If ACME confirms acceptance, we'll close the activation ticket and transition to standard incident/monitoring cadence.

Thanks — appreciate the smooth coordination.

Cheers,
